==Hero Usage==
* Heroes use this spell as a basic damage skill, ignoring its effects with overcast.

== Notes ==
* Provided that the prerequisites for additional damage of the skills are met, [[Lightning Bolt]], [[Lightning Hammer]], [[Lightning Orb]], and [[Mind Shock]] deal the same amount of damage from Air Magic rank 14 to 16.
{{anomaly| Similar to [[Incendiary Bonds]] and [[Lightning Surge]], [[List of hex removal skills|removing the hex]] before it ends will negate the [[end effect]], unlike [[Shatterstone]] and most other skills with an end effect.}}
{{anomaly|Despite the ambiguity of the concise description, the end effect damage also has 25% armor penetration.}}
